name: Quartz-bearing feedstock
description: Quartz or quartzite provides silica-bearing feed; mineral association and impurities require characterization.

name: Qualified quartz and carbon charge
description: Quartz and selected carbon reductants are prepared for furnace use; qualification is furnace-specific, not electronic-grade acceptance.

name: Metallurgical-grade silicon

name: Purified chlorosilane feed

name: Electronic-grade polysilicon
description: Purified deposited silicon is sized, cleaned and packaged to limit recontamination; electronic qualification is specification-dependent.

name: Single-crystal silicon ingot

name: Sliced silicon wafer
description: Slicing establishes a wafer blank that still needs surface and geometry finishing.

name: Finished polished wafer

name: Accepted starting wafer
description: A cleaned and inspected wafer meets a specified acceptance boundary; no universal numerical limits or downstream defect-free guarantee are implied.

name: Carbothermic silicon smelting
description: Electrical furnace heating and carbon reduction remove oxygen from silica through reactions involving SiO and SiC.

name: Chlorosilane synthesis
description: Convert metallurgical silicon to chlorosilanes suitable for purification.

name: Chemical purification by distillation
description: Separate chemical species through repeated vapor/liquid separation before deposition.

name: Polysilicon deposition
description: Deposit silicon from purified gas on heated silicon surfaces; subsequent clean handling protects the product.

name: Czochralski single-crystal growth
description: Grow an oriented silicon crystal from a seeded melt in a quartz crucible with thermal and motion control.

name: Ingot shaping and wafer slicing
description: Shape the ingot and cut wafer blanks; kerf and cutting damage precede finishing.

name: Wafer surface finishing
description: Group lapping, etching and polishing at overview level; removal of damage and control of geometry prepare the surface.

name: Wafer cleaning and acceptance inspection
description: Remove residual contamination and inspect against specified geometry, surface and electrical requirements.

name: Submerged-arc furnace
description: Electrodes and an electrically heated reacting burden supply conditions for silicon reduction.

name: Distillation equipment
description: Vapor/liquid separation purifies chlorosilane feed before silicon deposition.

name: Siemens deposition reactor
description: Heated silicon surfaces support gas-phase silicon deposition.

name: CZ crystal puller
description: Heater, crucible and seed-motion systems control growth of a single crystal.

name: Wafer slicing equipment
description: Mechanical cutting divides the ingot into wafer blanks.

name: Wafer polishing equipment
description: Mechanical and chemical action produces a smooth prepared wafer surface.

name: Laser-scattering surface inspection
description: Scattered laser light detects surface events under instrument-dependent sensitivity and classification limits.

name: Carbon reductants
description: Selected carbon-bearing feed participates in oxygen removal during silicon smelting.

name: High-purity quartz for crucibles
description: High-purity quartz can supply fused-quartz crucible manufacture; this is a separate use from silicon furnace ore.

name: Quartz crucible
description: A fused-quartz crucible contains the CZ melt and can contribute oxygen to it.

name: Hydrogen and hydrogen chloride process streams
description: Hydrogen/chlorine-bearing chemistry enables the representative TCS production and silicon deposition route; streams are separately conditioned.

name: Oriented silicon seed
description: The silicon seed establishes orientation for continued single-crystal growth.

name: Float-zone single-crystal growth
description: A traveling molten zone recrystallizes silicon without a contacting melt crucible; feed form and qualified applications differ from CZ.

name: Elkem
description: Elkem describes Tana quartzite extraction and industrial uses.

name: Sibelco
description: Sibelco describes IOTA high-purity quartz for making fused-quartz crucibles and quartzware.

name: WACKER
description: WACKER describes a chlorosilane/distillation and Siemens deposition route for polysilicon.

name: Hemlock Semiconductor
description: Hemlock describes TCS-based CVD and controlled polysilicon sizing, cleaning and packaging.

name: PVA TePla
description: PVA TePla describes CZ puller equipment and thermal and motion control functions.

name: Siltronic
description: Siltronic describes float-zone silicon products and their lower-oxygen and high-resistivity application context.

name: SUMCO
description: SUMCO describes wafer forming through slicing, lapping, etching, polishing, cleaning and inspection.

name: Carrier concentration
description: Mobile carrier concentration in cm^-3 at stated temperature, doping and equilibrium conditions; distinct from total chemical impurity count.

name: Electrical resistivity
description: Bulk resistivity in ohm cm under specified temperature and field; depends on carrier population and mobility.

name: Wafer geometry
description: Thickness variation, bow and warp are distinct measured geometry quantities; length units and measurement support/reference conditions must accompany limits.

name: Surface contamination outside specification
description: A particle or contamination measurement fails the defined wafer acceptance limit; detection sensitivity does not prove complete absence.

name: Geometry outside specification
description: Measured wafer geometry is outside its agreed specification; no universal numeric acceptance threshold is asserted.

name: Accepted wafer fraction
description: Accepted wafers divided by inspected wafers for a stated lot, specification and inspection boundary; dimensionless. Does not predict finished-die yield.

name: Specific process energy
description: Energy input in kWh divided by accepted silicon mass in kg for a stated process boundary and period; original accounting definition, no industrial benchmark.

name: Electrical resistivity outside specification
description: Bulk resistivity falls outside a selected acceptance range when carrier population or mobility changes under otherwise stated measurement conditions; no numerical limit supplied.

name: Fab unit processes
description: Repeated film formation, patterning, removal, property modification and measurement functions; not one serial recipe.

name: Resist patterning
description: Create a developed resist pattern for a subsequent compatible transfer operation.

name: Coat/develop track and exposure tool
description: Prepare resist, expose an aligned image and develop a physical resist pattern.

name: Film deposition
description: Add a film through a selected physical or chemical deposition mechanism.

name: Deposition reactor category
description: Deliver film-forming species under controlled surface and chamber conditions; method-specific tools differ.

name: Pattern transfer etch
description: Remove selected exposed material while retaining required masking and underlying structures.

name: Plasma etch chamber
description: Supply reactive species and ion assistance, control wafer conditions and remove reaction products.

name: Implant and activation sequence
description: Deliver dopant ions and apply a separately qualified activation treatment.

name: Ion implanter and anneal tools
description: Select and deliver ions; a separate thermal tool supplies the activation exposure.

name: Thermal oxidation
description: React oxidant with silicon to grow oxide while consuming underlying silicon.

name: Oxidation reactor
description: Control temperature, oxidant ambient and exposure time.

name: Resist strip and surface clean
description: Remove compatible masking/residual material and qualify the resulting surface for the next operation.

name: Compatible strip and clean tools
description: Provide material-specific residue removal, rinse and drying functions.

name: Chemical mechanical planarization
description: Remove overburden and reduce topography using coupled chemical and mechanical action.

name: CMP and post-clean system
description: Control pad/slurry contact and wafer loading; clean and dry the resulting surface.

name: Metrology and inspection
description: Measure selected properties or inspect for defects under a defined sampling and decision plan.

name: Optical/electron measurement tools
description: Obtain pattern or defect information with method-specific sensitivity and sampling.

name: Thermal oxide on silicon
description: Illustrative planar silicon wafer with a thermally grown oxide.

name: Resist-patterned oxide wafer
description: Illustrative developed resist openings above oxide on silicon.

name: Etched oxide with remaining resist
description: Illustrative selectively removed oxide regions; masking resist remains for strip.

name: Patterned oxide after strip
description: Illustrative patterned oxide/silicon surface after a compatible resist strip; no device functionality asserted.

name: Film thickness
description: Thickness measured with a specified method and interpretation model.

name: Pattern placement
description: Relative pattern placement assessed by an appropriate overlay measurement.

name: Local stochastic pattern failure
description: Local missing or bridging patterns can escape an average dimensional metric.

name: CMP dishing or erosion
description: Pattern-dependent excessive removal can change local surface geometry.

name: Device-to-wiring integration
description: Alternative device formation, terminal access and repeated wiring modules; fabrication scope only.

name: Planar device integration
description: Isolation/wells, planar gate, source/drain/spacer and activation functions prepare device terminals.

name: FinFET device integration
description: Fin definition and isolation, gate/source-drain integration and final gate formation prepare device terminals.

name: Nanosheet device integration
description: Alternating-layer preparation, inner spacers, source/drain attachment, selective channel release and surrounding gate prepare terminals.

name: MOL terminal contacts
description: Open and prepare selected terminal interfaces, form qualified conducting connections and isolate them from adjacent structures.

name: Wiring-level dielectric and cavity
description: Deposit a compatible dielectric stack and create connected trench/via cavities landing on selected lower conductors.

name: Barrier liner and seed
description: Prepare the cavity with qualified diffusion-blocking, adhesion and fill-nucleation functions.

name: Copper cavity fill
description: Fill the prepared trench/via cavity with conductor while controlling voids and overburden.

name: Wiring-level CMP and clean
description: Remove unwanted overburden while retaining isolated conductors and qualified local topography.

name: Additional levels and terminal finish
description: Aggregate further qualified wiring-level repetitions, passivation and terminal access; electrical test is outside this operation.

name: Electrochemical copper fill tool
description: Control electrodeposition into qualified seeded cavities; chemistry and transport influence filling behavior.

name: Device wafer ready for MOL
description: Abstract compatible device-terminal boundary reached by one alternative planar, fin or nanosheet route; not all three are required.

name: Device wafer with MOL contacts
description: Wafer with intended terminal connections ready for a qualified wiring module; no product test status.

name: Trench/via cavity wafer
description: Illustrative dielectric cavity state above selected lower conductors.

name: Prepared cavity wafer
description: Illustrative cavity carrying required barrier/liner/seed functions before conductor fill.

name: Filled wafer with overburden
description: Illustrative filled copper cavity with excess surface conductor still present.

name: One added wiring level
description: Illustrative isolated line/via geometry after CMP and cleaning; next levels require separate qualified instances.

name: Fabricated wired wafer - test pending
description: Aggregate wiring and terminal-finish boundary; not electrically accepted, thinned, diced or packaged.

name: Interconnect resistance and RC response
description: Geometry, effective material properties, driver and load determine the scoped circuit model.

name: Integrated conductor and dielectric condition
description: Barrier/liner integrity, dielectric response and stress history affect electrical reliability.

name: Contact or fill discontinuity
description: Poor interface or incomplete fill can raise resistance or interrupt intended connections.

name: Current-induced interconnect damage
description: Atomic transport and local flux divergence can create metal depletion or accumulation under relevant stress.
